response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(m.byte_rate - o.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.byte_rate > o.avg_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with zero milliseconds cannot have a defined byte rate, so they are excluded from rate averages but included in track counts.
